text:
Alex W: Looping everyone in — Tim, paste the customer POC ask? short summary pls
Tim S (AE): LumenHealth: 3-week POC. Goal = smart triage on intake forms -> suggest next step + confidence + small reasons list. Also reranking for downstream doc classification. Requires EU-only data residency. Ballpark traffic ~100k reqs/day (confirm).
Marie Chen: Quick clarifiers: 1) streaming needed? 2) Hosted vs Private preference? 3) exact endpoints?
Tim S (AE): No streaming. They prefer Private (VPC) for EU data, but Dedicated is ok if faster. Endpoints they expect: POST /triage, POST /classify-rerank, POST /embed-patient-notes
Jordan (Solutions): Proposed MVP order: 1) /triage — input: intake text -> output {intent, confidence, reasons(top3)} 2) /classify-rerank — candidates -> scores + best 3) /embed-patient-notes — similarity (low priority)
Samir K: Security/infrastructure asks: EU-only data plane, customer-managed KMS, SCIM/SSO, audit logs export (90d), DPA + SOC2 addendum.
Marie Chen: Add network isolation smoke test in Week 1 and pen-test scheduled Week 3 (customer requested).
Alex W: Eval weight proposal: quality/accuracy 50%, latency 25%, cost 15%, explainability coverage 10%. Open to adjust per customer.
Jordan (Solutions): Quick eval harness sketch for triage: - dataset: 1k labeled intake samples; - metrics: top1 accuracy, calibration, explanation-coverage; - run: 3 model variants x 5 seeds.
Marie Chen: Prompt/eval checklist notes: include adversarial inputs, truncated texts, common EU languages. Build 50-case smoke set + 1k labeled for deeper evals.
Tim S (AE): Customer asked: "delta Hosted / Dedicated / Private at this volume?" Need a 1-slide ballpark today for procurement.
Samir K: Rule-of-thumb for slide: Hosted = lowest setup, higher per-token cost; Dedicated = reserved GPU commit, lower unit cost + monthly commit; Private = highest setup + infra fee, lowest unit cost at scale + compliance add-on. I'll draft ranges.
Alex W: Ops note: include automatic failover plan — if Private capacity constrained route to Dedicated in EU. Measure failover latency in metrics.
Jordan (Solutions): Short prompt template for triage:
```
System: You are a medical intake assistant. Return JSON: {intent: string, confidence: 0-1, reasons: [short phrases]}
User: <intake text>
```
Marie Chen: Draft timeline: Week 0 kickoff (infra access, SCIM, KMS handshake); Week 1 deploy models + smoke eval (50 cases) + network isolation test; Week 2 run 1k evals, cost profiling, latency tuning; Week 3 security pen-test, acceptance tests + exec demo.
Jordan (Solutions): Candidate success criteria: triage >=85% top1 on 1k eval; p99 <1200ms (edge), p95 <800ms; explainability coverage >=90%; cost < $0.003 per inference (ballpark).
Tim S (AE): Customer also wants SLA and support level during POC — propose dedicated SE hours (8/wk) + on-call during demo window.
Samir K: For EU Private deploy we need customer infra contact + IP ranges by EOD Monday. Legal also needs sub-processor list for DPA — Tim pls collect.
Tim S (AE): I'll collect infra contact, IP ranges, sub-processor list, and confirm burst profile (they said ~100k/day).
Marie Chen: Action items: Jordan -> eval harness & prompt samples (48h); Alex -> failover routing + config template (48h); Samir -> security checklist + pricing ranges (72h); Tim -> infra contact + sub-processors + traffic profile (24h).
Evie-Bot: calendar created: "LumenHealth POC kickoff" Thu 09:30 UTC — invites sent to Alex W, Marie Chen, Jordan (Solutions), Samir K, Tim S (AE).
Tim S (AE): One more from customer: early Dedicated monthly commit estimate. Alex / Samir can you rough a 3-node GPU pool price for EU and estimated throughput? ballpark ok.
Alex W: Will assume A10G-equivalent nodes. 3-node pool -> ~1500 qps baseline with batching (est). I'll sketch the price on the slide.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll add the eval weight matrix to the exec slide so they see tradeoffs.
Samir K: If we hit security/legal blockers escalate to legal@redwood. Tim please cc legal when you send DPA questions.
Tim S (AE): Will do. Posting updates once I have infra contact and confirmed traffic.
Alex W: 👍
